decisions_made: Closed item (b)'s wrapper-level fuel-mismatch gap via a NEW parAncestor-based reconciliation lemma (isAccessible_reconcile_of_worldHist) rather than forcing item (a)'s go-level lemma into service -- confirms the prior dispatch's own prediction to reach for IWorldHistCounter/edges_shape_of_worldHist/parAncestor_of_isAccessible first, and avoids the downward-fuel-reduction problem entirely by re-deriving accessibility at the smaller edge list's own canonical fuel via IWorldHist's (H1-acc) clause, instead of trying to trim the larger list's witness.

Landed applyAllTImpRules_agrees_grow/applyPersistenceFixpoint_agrees_grow as free-standing lemmas, not yet wired into the induction -- the actual six-use-site rewiring (item (e)) needs induction-local origin/later IWorldHist witnesses and an edges_small subset edges_big containment fact not yet packaged as its own lemma; landing the composition lemmas first, decoupled from that wiring, keeps this dispatch's unit of work self-contained and verifiable.

Landed IReuseFrozen/IAllReuseFrozen with only STRUCTURAL companions (snoc/append/map_const), deliberately declining to attempt any growth-preservation ('IReuseFrozen_mono') lemma -- IFrozenBelow's universal quantifier over branch membership makes bigger branches a STRICTLY STRONGER requirement, not weaker, so naive monotonicity is false; genuine preservation needs the real freeze machinery (IFrozenBelow_intStepBranchPrio_ge + applyPersistenceFixpoint_agrees_grow), which is item (e)'s job, not a cheap corollary here.

Corrected, for the second time across two consecutive dispatches, a stray uncommitted Phase 7 [IN PROGRESS] marker (present at dispatch start on top of a clean prior commit, no corresponding task-body work) back to [NOT STARTED] -- flagged as a possible external/recurring issue outside this task's own dispatches, not something this dispatch can root-cause.
dead_ends: Did not attempt to reuse isAccessible_go_append_eq_of_fresh (item (a)) for item (b)'s composition -- the go-level lemma is fuel-preserving (same fuel both sides), which cannot resolve the wrapper-level fuel mismatch (edges.length+1 vs edges.length) without an additional downward fuel-saturation fact; the parAncestor route sidesteps needing any such fact.

Did not attempt a generic 'IReuseFrozen survives branch growth' lemma -- IFrozenBelow is not naively monotone in the branch (its universal quantifier ranges over branch membership, so bigger branches impose a strictly stronger, not weaker, requirement); this would need the full freeze-preservation machinery already landed as applyPersistenceFixpoint_agrees_grow, composed at an actual induction call site -- out of scope as a standalone lemma.
